title: ConfigCommentParser drops a __proto__ key from its results
body: Bug (npm workspaces monorepo, package packages/plugin-kit): ConfigCommentParser results are built so that a '__proto__' key is lost or changes the prototype instead of being kept as an own property.

Outcome: a '__proto__' key in a parsed config comment is preserved as an own property of the result, in every parse method that builds a result object; existing behaviour is unchanged. Fix packages/plugin-kit/src/config-comment-parser.js and add tests in packages/plugin-kit/tests/config-comment-parser.test.js.
